description: Search and filter members/accounts. Supports text search, date ranges, booking/activity history, membership tier, tags, and more. Use lastBookingBefore/inactiveDays to find inactive members.

createdAfter.description: ISO date — accounts created after this date

createdBefore.description: ISO date — accounts created before this date

hasBooking.description: Filter to members with/without any booking

hasMembership.description: Filter to members with active membership

inactiveDays.description: Members with no activity in the last N days

lastActivityAfter.description: ISO date — members with activity after this date

lastActivityBefore.description: ISO date — members with no activity since this date

lastBookingAfter.description: ISO date — members who have a booking after this date

lastBookingBefore.description: ISO date — members whose last booking is before this date (or have no bookings)

search.description: Name, email, or phone to search

sort.description: Sort column: name, email, or createdAt

name: search_members

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
